description:
## Problem
The post-load seam (PR #2677, merge 4cfa94006b6d563946aacb68f64cb15be0c4a98b) moved maintenance out of apply_unified_tuning and into per-table hooks: ClickHouse OPTIMIZE (opt-in `optimize_after_load`), Redshift ANALYZE (only when `auto_analyze` is off), Databricks Delta OPTIMIZE + ANALYZE, Snowflake RESUME RECLUSTER. It was verified only with fake drivers (all platforms except ClickHouse local) and with chDB 3.6.0 on ClickHouse local. Nothing ran against a live Redshift, Databricks, ClickHouse server or ClickHouse cloud. Synapse and the other adapters that gained the `run_post_load_tunings` call site are also fake-driver only. Snowflake has its own item: snowflake-tuned-live-certification-20261001.

## Change
For each platform, run one tuned scale-factor-0.01 TPC-H run through the real CLI and record: statements executed per table in the `post_load` phase, no maintenance during `apply_unified_tuning`, `phases.post_load_maintenance` present with sensible duration and status, `data_loading` excluding it, verdict (`applied_verified` where an introspector exists), and that a refused statement turns the phase FAILED without breaking the run.
- Redshift: confirm the isolated VACUUM/ANALYZE pass and the hook do not both run with default settings.
- Databricks: confirm one OPTIMIZE per tuned Delta table and the layout-operation records.
- ClickHouse server and cloud: confirm `optimize_after_load` is honoured and the curated templates create tables.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- No live cloud run without explicit owner approval naming the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Never relax an assertion to pass.
